summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked; one WebSearch used, which located only third-party copies of superseded Allocation of Business Rules). 73 source leads recorded, almost all reused verbatim from 04A, 04B, 17A-17E, 11A and the shared lead register, plus the Allocation of Business Rules copies and four portals marked 'URL from general knowledge - unverified'. Q1 (which Nepali institution owns each cross-border agreement) is set up as a 17-row responsibility matrix; every candidate owner is a to-verify hypothesis pending the current Allocation of Business Rules and each agreement's designation of implementing authorities. Q2 (where opportunities with one neighbour interact with commitments to the other) is set up as a 10-item conflict map of documented structural interactions to verify from clause text (e.g. eligibility clauses in Indian cross-border electricity rules, rules of origin, third-country goods, transit exclusivity, gauge standards, airspace entry, currency settlement, basin treaty scope, financing terms); no statement is made about any government's intentions. Q3 (measurable effects of existing agreements) is a 10-row documented-effects register listing the evaluation studies to retrieve; no Nepal-specific ex-post econometric evaluation of the India or China agreements was located. The neighbour-dependency register combines the 5 India rows (04A) and 4 China rows (04B) and adds one water-treaty row. All empirical items pending; no numbers recorded. This work does not represent any government.

findings.period: current Allocation of Business Rules as at retrieval (2026)
findings.note: Requires the current Government of Nepal (Allocation of Business) Rules (04C-L04; superseded copies 04C-L02, L03 only as locators), the Nepal Treaty Act (04C-L09), the constitutional treaty-ratification provision (04C-L07, L08) and each agreement text's implementing-authority clause.

findings.note: An item is recorded as a conflict only if a retrieved clause or official record establishes it; otherwise it is closed as 'no conflict documented'.

findings.claim: Q3: Measurable economic effects of existing India-Nepal and China-Nepal agreements documented in evaluation studies (trade, transit time/cost, power trade, water benefits, peg transmission).
findings.period: study-specific; Nepal FY vs calendar year to be recorded per study
findings.note: Register in specific.documented_effects; no Nepal-specific ex-post evaluation of the Treaty of Trade or China transit protocol located in r1; World Bank NIRTTP completion report not located.

findings.claim: Method: responsibility is assigned from the Allocation of Business Rules first and the agreement's implementing-authority clause second; where they differ both are recorded and the difference flagged, not resolved by judgement.
Method: the conflict map records only structural interactions evidenced by texts, official records or implementation data; it does not attribute motives or predict any government's conduct.
Method: ex-ante assessments (e.g. of the long-term power trade agreement) are kept separate from ex-post evaluations and never used as documented effects.
This analysis is independent research; it does not state or represent the position of the Government of Nepal, India or China.

assumptions.text: Candidate institutions in the responsibility matrix are retrieval hypotheses from general domain knowledge, not findings.
Agreement status classes follow 17B-A1/17D-A1; 04C records ownership, not status.
A conflict-map item is closed 'not documented' if the retrieved texts contain no relevant clause; absence of evidence is recorded explicitly.
Documented effects use each study's own period basis (Nepal FY or calendar year); no conversion without a documented method.

challenges.text: 04A agreement_inventory omits the water instruments (Mahakali, Kosi, Gandak) and the Nepal-India BIPPA; 04C adds them to the responsibility matrix from 25B/26D leads - please include or cross-reference in 04A r2.

04B and 04A both map dependencies to EXP-03 (India partner share and China origin share). The combined register keeps them as separate rows; please confirm 16B should hold one exposure with partner, origin and route components rather than two.

CM-01 (eligibility clauses in Indian cross-border electricity rules vs Chinese-developed/financed plants) sits between 17A and 17B; please record the clause verification in one place (17A power_trade_rules) and reference it from 17B.
Add catalog ids for OPMCM (Allocation of Business Rules), MoICS, MoEWRI, Supreme Court decision texts and CAAN route documents; 04C leads use null or nearest ids.

The ratification route of the long-term power trade agreement (Supreme Court verdict) affects whether contracted volumes can be treated as legally settled; 22B holds the news lead - please retrieve the verdict from the Supreme Court host in r2.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no document retrieved. Candidate institutional owners are hypotheses; allocation of business has changed across versions (2064, 2072, 2074 BS) and may have been amended since. Conflict-map items may prove to have no clause-level basis. Evaluation literature on Nepal's bilateral agreements appears thin and heterogeneous; effects may remain pending beyond r2. Instruments signed in 2025-2026 are known only from news locators.

conflict_map.question: Q2 Where do opportunities with one neighbour conflict with commitments to the other?
conflict_map.method: Each item states a structural interaction to be confirmed from clause text or official records; outcome per item: DOCUMENTED_CONFLICT, DOCUMENTED_COMPLEMENTARITY, NO_CLAUSE_FOUND or PENDING. No statement about intentions of any government.

items.interaction: Whether Indian cross-border electricity rules condition approval of imports from Nepali generators on the ownership, developer or financing origin of the plant (including participation of entities from countries without a bilateral power arrangement with India), which would bear on Chinese-built or Chinese-financed hydropower in Nepal.
items.type: potential eligibility constraint - to verify from clause text
items.evidence_required: Exact clauses of MoP Guidelines 2018 (as amended), CEA DA Procedure and CERC CBTE Regulations on eligibility; CEA approvals list by project with developer identity; any NEA/IBN record of export ineligibility

items.interaction: Whether Treaty of Trade preferential access into India requires Nepali content/value-addition or change-in-tariff criteria that limit use of Chinese-origin inputs in exports to India; and whether China's LDC zero-tariff origin rules limit use of Indian-origin inputs.
items.evidence_required: Rules-of-origin clauses and protocol of the Treaty of Trade; China's LDC zero-tariff origin rules; customs certificate-of-origin procedures

items.interaction: Whether provisions on third-country goods in the India-Nepal unauthorised-trade agreement constrain onward movement into India of goods imported from China through northern ports, and how this shapes the scale of northern-route imports.
items.evidence_required: Clauses on third-country goods and re-export in the revised agreement; IGC records of issues raised

items.interaction: Complementarity or substitution between the Treaty of Transit (India ports/corridors) and the Nepal-China transit transport protocol (access via Chinese ports and dry ports): whether either text contains exclusivity, most-favoured or reciprocity clauses, and the documented operational use of the northern transit route.
items.type: route substitution - operational record to verify
items.evidence_required: Both transit texts; any cargo movement records under the China protocol; customs office-level trade

items.interaction: Whether cross-border rail projects with India and the proposed cross-border railway with China are specified on different track gauges or technical standards, which would affect network integration and the domestic investment programme.
items.type: technical standards interaction - to verify from feasibility/DPR documents
items.evidence_required: Feasibility study or DPR records for India-Nepal and China-Nepal rail projects stating gauge and standards

items.interaction: Whether international flight operations at airports in Nepal (including those financed or built with Chinese participation) depend on air-route and entry-point arrangements involving Indian airspace; documented status of such arrangements.
items.evidence_required: CAAN/ICAO route documentation and bilateral records on entry points; airport operating statistics

items.interaction: Nepal settles India trade in INR under the peg and exchange-control framework while China trade is settled in convertible currency (to verify); the INR/convertible split shapes reserve composition and the cost of diversifying imports northward.
items.evidence_required: NRB rules and data on currency composition of payments by partner; RBI supplement

items.interaction: Whether provisions of the Mahakali, Kosi and Gandak instruments (water use, prior consultation, benefit sharing) apply to projects on the same basins developed with other partners, including Chinese developers or financiers.
items.evidence_required: Treaty clauses on water use and third-party projects; project list by basin and developer (DoED/IBN)

items.interaction: Financing modality in the BRI framework (grant vs loan vs commercial) and its interaction with Nepal's debt strategy and with parallel Indian lines of credit/grants for connectivity projects on overlapping corridors.
items.evidence_required: BRI framework financing clause; DCR commitments and disbursements by India and China; MTDS limits

items.interaction: Reported 2026 Indian import-side measures on Nepali goods and the reported September 2026 treaty review: interaction with Nepal's export diversification (including northward) and with Treaty of Trade safeguard/consultation clauses.
items.evidence_required: Indian primary notifications; IGSC minutes; Treaty of Trade safeguard and consultation clauses

documented_effects.question: Q3 What measurable economic effects of existing agreements are documented?
documented_effects.method: For each study record: agreement, outcome, period (FY/calendar), method and identification, estimate with observation id, and whether ex-ante or ex-post. Conflicting estimates are kept side by side (00B). News claims are never effects.

register.effect_sought: Change in Nepal exports/imports with India attributable to treaty preferences and revisions; preference utilisation
register.method_required: Before/after with controls or gravity model; identify revision years from text
register.status: pending - no Nepal-specific ex-post evaluation located in r1

register.agreement: Treaty of Transit and rail-services agreement (India)
register.effect_sought: Transit time and cost changes for third-country cargo; modal shift to rail
register.method_required: Project results frameworks and completion reports; time-release or corridor studies

register.method_required: Implementation Completion and Results Report (not yet located)

register.method_required: NEA energy balance by FY; CEA approvals; ex-ante studies kept separate from ex-post

register.agreement: Mahakali, Kosi and Gandak water instruments
register.effect_sought: Documented irrigation/power benefits and losses to Nepal; implementation delay effects
register.method_required: Case studies; record whether quantitative or qualitative; no aggregation across studies

register.method_required: NRB econometric study; record specification and period

register.method_required: Customs office-level trade by FY; disruption event records

register.method_required: Preference utilisation data (China customs) - no catalog id
